users.name: users

password_hash.name: password_hash
password_hash.comment: Password hash only; never plaintexmvt or reversible encryption.

users.comment: 1. Accounts: individual sign-in identities; never share a squad password.

user_roles.name: user_roles
user_roles.comment: 1. Platform roles. Guests have no account or guest role row.

auth_tokens.name: auth_tokens
auth_tokens.comment: 1. Hashed session/reset/verification tokens; consume or rotate atomically.

games.name: games
games.comment: 2. Supported games. Adding a game inserts catalog data and does not alter the ERD.

game_modes.name: game_modes
game_modes.comment: 2. Game-specific formats such as MLBB Custom 5v5 or Valorant Standard 5v5.

game_roles.name: game_roles
game_roles.comment: 2. Game-specific player roles; examples are Tank, Mage, Duelist and Support.

regions.name: regions
regions.comment: 2. Matchmaking regions and IANA timezone defaults.

game_ranks.name: game_ranks
game_ranks.comment: 2. Rank catalog scoped to a game; new games add rows rather than rank columns.

squad_levels.name: squad_levels
squad_levels.comment: 2. Squad classification, e.g. Amateur or Collegiate, independent of MLBB rank.

game_characters.name: game_characters
game_characters.comment: 2. Optional selectable characters: MLBB heroes, Valorant agents, or equivalent game entities.

stat_definitions.name: stat_definitions
stat_definitions.comment: 2. Defines game-specific statistics without adding columns for each new game.

media_assets.name: media_assets
media_assets.comment: 2. Object-storage metadata for avatars, posts and evidence. No binary files or expiring signed URLs in SQL.

squads.name: squads

public_number.name: public_number
public_number.comment: Human-friendly ABYSS display ID, not the MLBB squad ID or an authorization secret.

squads.comment: 3. One competitive squad for one game and mode. Create another squad row for a different game without changing the ERD.

squad_coaches.name: squad_coaches
squad_coaches.comment: 3. Coaches are the authorized squad representatives. A primary coach manages the roster, matchmaking and coach-to-coach contact.

check_left_at_IS_NULL_OR_l.name: check_left_at_IS_NULL_OR_l
check_left_at_IS_NULL_OR_l.detail: left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= joined_at

player_profiles.name: player_profiles

real_name.name: real_name
real_name.comment: Private optional identity detail; exclude from public display views.

player_profiles.comment: 3. Permanent platform player identity. Coach-created profiles remain unclaimed until the real player links a user account.

check_ownership_status__cl.name: check_ownership_status__cl
check_ownership_status__cl.detail:
(ownership_status = 'claimed' AND linked_user_id IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR ownership_status <> 'claimed'

player_game_profiles.name: player_game_profiles
player_game_profiles.comment: 3. A permanent player account within one game. It survives squad transfers and retains career statistics.

player_game_roles.name: player_game_roles
player_game_roles.comment: 3. Ordered role preferences for a player in a particular game.

player_character_pool.name: player_character_pool
player_character_pool.comment: 3. Optional character pool for the player game profile; works for heroes, agents, or equivalent characters.

squad_memberships.name: squad_memberships
squad_memberships.comment: 3. Historical squad membership. Leaving sets left_at; the player game profile and match history are never deleted.

check_left_at_IS_NULL_OR_l.name: check_left_at_IS_NULL_OR_l
check_left_at_IS_NULL_OR_l.detail: left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= joined_at

player_profile_claims.name: player_profile_claims
player_profile_claims.comment: 3. A player can claim a coach-created profile. Approval links the existing profile to the user instead of creating a duplicate.

check_status__pending_AND_.name: check_status__pending_AND_
check_status__pending_AND_.detail:
(status = 'pending' AND reviewed_at IS NULL)
        OR (status IN ('approved','rejected') AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR status = 'cancelled'

player_team_preferences.name: player_team_preferences
player_team_preferences.comment: 3. Opt-in free-agent preferences. Public discovery only includes claimed profiles without an active squad membership.

squad_availability.name: squad_availability
squad_availability.comment: 4. Optional concrete availability windows. A later service can expand recurring availability.

scrim_invites.name: scrim_invites
scrim_invites.comment: 4. Received and sent invites query the same authoritative invitation.

check_status__pending_AND_.name: check_status__pending_AND_
check_status__pending_AND_.detail: (status = 'pending' AND responded_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'pending' AND responded_at IS NOT NULL)

scrims.name: scrims
scrims.comment: 4. Two squads per series. Handler copies accepted terms atomically and locks both squads to prevent overlaps.

check_actual_end_IS_NULL_O.name: check_actual_end_IS_NULL_O
check_actual_end_IS_NULL_O.detail: actual_end IS NULL OR (actual_start IS NOT NULL AND actual_end >= actual_start)

scrim_reschedule_requests.name: scrim_reschedule_requests
scrim_reschedule_requests.comment: 4. Opposing squad accepts negotiated changes; stale proposals cannot overwrite newer schedules.

check_status__pending_AND_.name: check_status__pending_AND_
check_status__pending_AND_.detail: (status = 'pending' AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'pending' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)

match_participants.name: match_participants
match_participants.comment: 4. Historical match lineup. It records the membership and game profile used at match time, so transfers cannot rewrite prior participation.

participant_stat_values.name: participant_stat_values
participant_stat_values.comment: 4. Game-defined participant statistics. New games and metrics add definition/value rows without ERD changes.

result_submissions.name: result_submissions
result_submissions.comment: 5. Preserve submitted claims; corrections are new rows. Only approved claims become canonical results.

result_evidence.name: result_evidence
result_evidence.comment: 5. Screenshot proof and optional OCR output for moderator logs. OCR success does not establish result validity.

scrim_results.name: scrim_results
scrim_results.comment: 5. One canonical series result. FinalizeResult validates accepted claim, scores and series rules.

check_outcome__home_win_AN.name: check_outcome__home_win_AN
check_outcome__home_win_AN.detail:
(outcome = 'home_win' AND home_wins > away_wins)
        OR (outcome = 'away_win' AND away_wins > home_wins)
        OR (outcome = 'draw' AND home_wins = away_wins) OR outcome = 'void'

rating_seasons.name: rating_seasons
rating_seasons.comment: 5. ABYSS rating periods and versioned rules scoped to a game mode, independent of official game ranks.

squad_ratings.name: squad_ratings
squad_ratings.comment: 5. Authoritative platform rating for matchmaking, not a client-editable profile field.

rating_changes.name: rating_changes
rating_changes.comment: 5. Auditable, deduplicated rating effects; corrections require a defined adjustment/recalculation policy.

squad_posts.name: squad_posts
squad_posts.comment: 6. Home/profile feed posts with optional label and public or squad-only visibility.

post_assets.name: post_assets
post_assets.comment: 6. Ordered post attachments; handler requires text or at least one attachment.

conversations.name: conversations
conversations.comment: 6. One direct conversation per unordered squad pair; UUID ordering canonicalizes the pair.

messages.name: messages
messages.comment: 6. Coach-to-coach messages. The composite foreign key proves that the sender is a coach of the sending squad.

conversation_reads.name: conversation_reads
conversation_reads.comment: 6. Individual read cursor for each authorized representative; advance monotonically.

notifications.name: notifications
notifications.comment: 7. Durable notification/read state; source-event ID deduplicates retries without FK to the prunable outbox.

feedback.name: feedback
feedback.comment: 8. Platform feedback and optional scrim feedback; not an automatic disciplinary report.

reports.name: reports
reports.comment: 8. Alleged misconduct requiring human review; a report is not proof of an offense.

check_status_IN_resolveddi.name: check_status_IN_resolveddi
check_status_IN_resolveddi.detail:
(status IN ('resolved','dismissed') AND resolved_by IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolution IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status IN ('open','investigating') AND resolved_at IS NULL)

report_evidence.name: report_evidence
report_evidence.comment: 8. Private attachments; check access before issuing signed object URLs.

squad_verifications.name: squad_verifications
squad_verifications.comment: 8. Squad-level proof and decision history. Approval updates squad level/verification in the same transaction.

check_status__pending_AND_.name: check_status__pending_AND_
check_status__pending_AND_.detail:
(status = 'pending' AND reviewed_at IS NULL)
        OR (status <> 'pending' AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL)

sanctions.name: sanctions
sanctions.comment: 8. Warnings, suspensions and bans with expiry/revocation history; only authorized moderation commands create them.

check_squad_id_IS_NOT_NULL.name: check_squad_id_IS_NOT_NULL
check_squad_id_IS_NOT_NULL.detail: (squad_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL) OR (squad_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL)

check_ends_at_IS_NULL_OR_e.name: check_ends_at_IS_NULL_OR_e
check_ends_at_IS_NULL_OR_e.detail: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

content_items.name: content_items
content_items.comment: 9. Separate records for events, videos, ads and internal notes; avoids one wide row per landing-page layout.

check_ends_at_IS_NULL_OR_s.name: check_ends_at_IS_NULL_OR_s
check_ends_at_IS_NULL_OR_s.detail: ends_at IS NULL OR starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

audit_log.name: audit_log
audit_log.comment: 9. Append-only scrim/invite/staff history. Allowlisted details exclude secrets and raw private evidence.

request_receipts.name: request_receipts
request_receipts.comment: 10. Completed request responses saved with changes; reject the same key with a different request.

event_outbox.name: event_outbox

event_index.name: event_index
event_index.comment: Multiple events can share one aggregate version; preserve order by version and event index.

event_outbox.comment: 10. Business changes/events commit together. Leased publisher retries with at-least-once delivery; not an event-sourcing store.

event_receipts.name: event_receipts
event_receipts.comment: 10. One receipt per event consumer, preventing duplicated event handling.
